filter_combined_genus <- function(m,
                                  prev_thresh    = PARAMS$prevalence_threshold,
                                  abund_thresh   = PARAMS$abundance_threshold,
                                  placeholder_re = "^g__(GGB|FGB|OFGB|CFGB)") {
  otu <- as.matrix(m$otu_table)
  sm  <- as.data.frame(m$sample_table)

  passes_in <- function(cohort_label) {
    cols <- rownames(sm)[sm$Cohort == cohort_label]
    sub  <- otu[, cols, drop = FALSE]
    prev <- rowMeans(sub > 0)
    mab  <- rowMeans(sub)
    prev >= prev_thresh & mab >= abund_thresh
  }

  pass_sheba <- passes_in("Sheba")
  pass_pitt  <- passes_in("Pitt")
  drop_ph    <- grepl(placeholder_re, rownames(otu))

  cat("Filter cascade for combined-cohort genus DA:\n")
  cat("  starting:                       ", nrow(otu), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  placeholder genera (excluded):  ", sum(drop_ph), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  passes prev/abund in Sheba:     ", sum(pass_sheba & !drop_ph), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  passes prev/abund in Pitt:      ", sum(pass_pitt  & !drop_ph), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  in BOTH (intersection, kept):   ", sum(pass_sheba & pass_pitt & !drop_ph), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Sheba-only (excluded):          ", sum(pass_sheba & !pass_pitt & !drop_ph), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Pitt-only  (excluded):          ", sum(pass_pitt  & !pass_sheba & !drop_ph), "\n", sep = "")

  keep <- pass_sheba & pass_pitt & !drop_ph
  m$otu_table <- m$otu_table[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  m$tax_table <- m$tax_table[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  m$tidy_dataset()
  m
}

# ---- 11. Combined alpha diversity (cohort-adjusted) -------------------
combo_genus$cal_alphadiv()
ad <- as.data.frame(combo_genus$alpha_diversity)
if (!"SampleID" %in% colnames(ad)) ad$SampleID <- rownames(ad)

sm <- as.data.frame(combo_genus$sample_table)
if (!"SampleID" %in% colnames(sm)) sm$SampleID <- rownames(sm)

alpha_combo <- left_join(
  ad,
  sm[, c("SampleID", "Response", "Cohort", "Treatment_regimen")],
  by = "SampleID"
)

# Indices microeco actually computes on relab data (Shannon/Simpson/InvSimpson;
# Observed/Chao1/ACE/Fisher are skipped because they need integer counts).
alpha_metrics <- intersect(c("Shannon", "Simpson", "InvSimpson", "Coverage"),
                           colnames(alpha_combo))
cat("Available α-indices:", paste(alpha_metrics, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

run_alpha_models <- function(metric) {
  cat("===== ", metric, " =====\n", sep = "")

  f1 <- as.formula(paste(metric, "~ Response + Cohort"))
  f2 <- as.formula(paste(metric, "~ Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen"))
  fit1 <- lm(f1, data = alpha_combo)
  fit2 <- lm(f2, data = alpha_combo)

  cat("\n-- M1: ~ Response + Cohort --\n")
  print(round(summary(fit1)$coefficients, 4))

  cat("\n-- M2: ~ Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen --\n")
  print(round(summary(fit2)$coefficients, 4))

  cat("\n-- ANOVA M2 vs M1 (does Treatment_regimen add information?) --\n")
  print(anova(fit1, fit2))

  invisible(list(M1 = fit1, M2 = fit2))
}

alpha_fits <- lapply(alpha_metrics, run_alpha_models)
names(alpha_fits) <- alpha_metrics

# Compact summary across metrics
cat("\n===== Compact summary =====\n")
summary_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(alpha_metrics, function(m) {
  c1 <- summary(alpha_fits[[m]]$M1)$coefficients
  c2 <- summary(alpha_fits[[m]]$M2)$coefficients
  data.frame(
    Metric            = m,
    Resp_p_M1         = round(c1["ResponseResponder", "Pr(>|t|)"], 4),
    Resp_beta_M1      = round(c1["ResponseResponder", "Estimate"],  4),
    Cohort_p_M1       = round(c1["CohortPitt",        "Pr(>|t|)"], 4),
    Resp_p_M2         = round(c2["ResponseResponder", "Pr(>|t|)"], 4),
    Trt_p_M2          = round(c2[grep("Treatment_regimen", rownames(c2))[1], "Pr(>|t|)"], 4),
    AnovaP_M1_vs_M2   = round(anova(alpha_fits[[m]]$M1, alpha_fits[[m]]$M2)$`Pr(>F)`[2], 4),
    stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
  )
}))
print(summary_tab)

write_tsv(summary_tab, file.path(paths$out_dir, "alpha_combined_summary.tsv"))

#### Beta-diversity
```{r}

# ---- 12. Combined beta diversity -------------------------------------
run_beta <- function(method_label, dist_method) {
  cat("\n========  ", method_label, "  ========\n", sep = "")

  otu_t <- t(as.matrix(combo_genus$otu_table))

  if (dist_method == "aitchison") {
    # vegan::vegdist adds pseudocount internally; pseudocount=1 is fine for
    # percentage-scale relab data. If your otu_table is on proportion scale,
    # the result is invariant up to a constant — relative ordering preserved.
    d <- vegan::vegdist(otu_t, method = "aitchison", pseudocount = 1)
  } else {
    d <- vegan::vegdist(otu_t, method = "bray")
  }

  sm <- as.data.frame(combo_genus$sample_table)
  sm <- sm[labels(d), , drop = FALSE]

  # Marginal PERMANOVA — matches §13 covariate set
  set.seed(42)
  ad_marg <- vegan::adonis2(
    d ~ Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen, data = sm,
    permutations = PARAMS$permanova_perms, by = "margin"
  )
  cat("\n-- Marginal PERMANOVA (Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen) --\n")
  print(ad_marg)

  # Cohort-stratified PERMANOVA — within-cohort Response signal
  set.seed(42)
  ad_strat <- vegan::adonis2(
    d ~ Response, data = sm, strata = sm$Cohort,
    permutations = PARAMS$permanova_perms
  )
  cat("\n-- Stratified PERMANOVA (Response | Cohort strata) --\n")
  print(ad_strat)

  # PERMDISP — does Cohort or Response have heterogeneous dispersion?
  set.seed(42)
  pd_coh <- vegan::permutest(vegan::betadisper(d, sm$Cohort),
                             permutations = PARAMS$permanova_perms)
  set.seed(42)
  pd_res <- vegan::permutest(vegan::betadisper(d, sm$Response),
                             permutations = PARAMS$permanova_perms)
  cat("\n-- PERMDISP --\n")
  cat("Cohort:   F=", round(pd_coh$tab$F[1], 3),
      "  p=", round(pd_coh$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], 4), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Response: F=", round(pd_res$tab$F[1], 3),
      "  p=", round(pd_res$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], 4), "\n", sep = "")

  # PCoA
  ord <- ape::pcoa(d)
  eig <- 100 * ord$values$Relative_eig
  pcoa_df <- data.frame(PC1 = ord$vectors[, 1], PC2 = ord$vectors[, 2]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    left_join(rownames_to_column(sm, "SampleID"), by = "SampleID")

  p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Response, shape = Cohort)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = Response), type = "t", level = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Non_responder" = "#ff7f00",
                                  "Responder"     = "#6a3d9a")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Sheba" = 16, "Pitt" = 17)) +
    labs(x = sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", eig[1]),
         y = sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", eig[2]),
         title = sprintf("Combined PCoA — %s", method_label)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)

  ggsave(file.path(paths$out_dir,
                   sprintf("beta_diversity_combined_%s.svg", dist_method)),
         p, width = 7, height = 5)

  list(dist = d, ad_marg = ad_marg, ad_strat = ad_strat,
       pd_coh = pd_coh, pd_res = pd_res, plot = p)
}

beta_aitch <- run_beta("Aitchison (primary)",      "aitchison")
beta_bray  <- run_beta("Bray-Curtis (sensitivity)", "bray")

# Cross-metric summary (just the marginal model)

              beta_bray $ad_marg["Cohort",   "R2"]),
  Coh_p   = c(beta_aitch$ad_marg["Cohort",   "Pr(>F)"],
              beta_bray $ad_marg["Cohort",   "Pr(>F)"]),
  Trt_R2  = c(beta_aitch$ad_marg["Treatment_regimen", "R2"],

print(beta_bray$plot)

# ---- 13. Combined differential abundance (3 methods) ------------------
# Covariate set: Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen (locked decision #2)
# All three methods take all three covariates; ALDEx2 via aldex.glm so it
# adjusts (per-cohort §7 used unadjusted aldex.ttest as triangulation; the
# combined model needs covariate adjustment because Cohort is so dominant).

# --- 13a. MaAsLin3 -----------------------------------------------------
# run_maaslin3_v4 already subsets metadata to formula columns (handoff fix #4)
# Populate the missing slot before the wrapper call
combo_genus$cal_abund()
cat("Genera in taxa_abund$Genus: ", nrow(combo_genus$taxa_abund$Genus),
    "  (should match otu_table: ", nrow(combo_genus$otu_table), ")\n", sep = "")

# Now retry MaAsLin3
m3_combined <- run_maaslin3_v4(
  combo_genus,
  output_dir              = file.path(paths$out_dir, "maaslin3_combined_genus"),
  fixed_effects           = c("Response", "Cohort", "Treatment_regimen"),
  reference               = "Response,Non_responder;Cohort,Sheba;Treatment_regimen,anti-PD1",
  drop_placeholder_genera = FALSE
)
m3_res <- m3_combined$fit_data_abundance$results %>%
  filter(metadata == "Response") %>%
  arrange(qval_individual)
cat("MaAsLin3 q<0.10 hits:", sum(m3_res$qval_individual < 0.10), "\n")

# --- 13b. LinDA --------------------------------------------------------
otu_mat <- as.data.frame(combo_genus$otu_table)
sm_combo <- as.data.frame(combo_genus$sample_table)

ld_combined <- MicrobiomeStat::linda(
  feature.dat       = otu_mat,
  meta.dat          = sm_combo,
  formula           = "~ Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen",
  feature.dat.type  = "proportion",
  prev.filter       = 0,            # already filtered upstream
  mean.abund.filter = 0,
  adaptive          = TRUE,
  p.adj.method      = "BH",
  alpha             = 0.10
)
ld_res <- ld_combined$output$ResponseResponder %>%
  rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
  arrange(pvalue)
cat("LinDA q<0.10 hits:", sum(ld_res$padj < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# --- 13c. ALDEx2 (covariate-adjusted via aldex.glm) --------------------
# aldex.glm needs integer-ish counts. relab × 1e6 + small pseudocount is the
# standard workaround for proportional input — preserves ratios exactly under
# CLR, only the constant changes.
counts_pseudo <- round(otu_mat * 1e6) + 1L
mm <- model.matrix(~ Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen, data = sm_combo)

set.seed(42)
ax_clr <- ALDEx2::aldex.clr(counts_pseudo, mm, mc.samples = 128, denom = "all")
ax_glm <- ALDEx2::aldex.glm(ax_clr, mm)

# Pull the Response coefficient block (column names follow aldex.glm convention)
resp_col <- grep("ResponseResponder.*pval\\.holm$|ResponseResponder.*pval\\.padj$|ResponseResponder.*BH",
                 colnames(ax_glm), value = TRUE)
cat("ALDEx2 columns matching Response:\n"); print(resp_col)

# Defensive extraction — exact column names depend on ALDEx2 version
ax_res <- data.frame(
  feature  = rownames(ax_glm),
  estimate = ax_glm[, "ResponseResponder:Est"],
  stderr   = ax_glm[, "ResponseResponder:SE"],
  tval     = ax_glm[, "ResponseResponder:t.val"],
  pvalue   = ax_glm[, "ResponseResponder:pval"],
  padj     = ax_glm[, "ResponseResponder:pval.padj"],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% arrange(pvalue)

cat("ALDEx2 q<0.10 hits:    ", sum(ax_res$padj   < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("ALDEx2 raw p<0.05 hits:", sum(ax_res$pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")
print(head(ax_res, 10))

write_tsv(ax_res, file.path(paths$out_dir, "DA_combined_aldex2.tsv"))

# --- Save all three for §13.5 ------------------------------------------
write_tsv(m3_res, file.path(paths$out_dir, "DA_combined_maaslin3.tsv"))
write_tsv(ld_res, file.path(paths$out_dir, "DA_combined_linda.tsv"))
write_tsv(ax_res, file.path(paths$out_dir, "DA_combined_aldex2.tsv"))

# --- Quick top-10 each method ------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== MaAsLin3 top 10 by q ===\n")
print(m3_res %>% select(feature, coef, stderr, pval_individual, qval_individual) %>% head(10))
cat("\n=== LinDA top 10 by p ===\n")
print(ld_res   %>% select(feature, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, pvalue, padj)        %>% head(10))
cat("\n=== ALDEx2 top 10 by p ===\n")
print(ax_res   %>% head(10))

# §13.5a — Genus-level verification table (Slackia/Eggerthella/Lachnospira)
genus_targets <- c("g__Slackia", "g__Eggerthella", "g__Lachnospira")

# §7-derived expectations (from handoff)
expected <- tribble(
  ~feature,         ~per_cohort_tier,                                    ~expected_dir,
  "g__Slackia",     "Moderate: LinDA q=0.06 Sheba, MaAsLin3 prev p=0.0098 Sheba; Pitt directionally consistent p=0.5",  "NR",
  "g__Eggerthella", "Bilateral nominal but sign-discordant between cohorts",                                              NA,
  "g__Lachnospira", "Bilateral nominal, weak; direction uncertain",                                                       NA
)

m3_t <- m3_res %>% filter(feature %in% genus_targets) %>%
  transmute(feature, m3_coef = coef, m3_p = pval_individual, m3_q = qval_individual,
            m3_dir = ifelse(coef < 0, "NR", "R"))
ld_t <- ld_res %>% filter(feature %in% genus_targets) %>%
  transmute(feature, ld_lfc = log2FoldChange, ld_p = pvalue, ld_q = padj,
            ld_dir = ifelse(log2FoldChange < 0, "NR", "R"))
ax_t <- ax_res %>% filter(feature %in% genus_targets) %>%
  transmute(feature, ax_est = estimate, ax_p = pvalue, ax_q = padj,
            ax_dir = ifelse(estimate < 0, "NR", "R"))

verif_genus <- expected %>%
  left_join(m3_t, by = "feature") %>%
  left_join(ld_t, by = "feature") %>%
  left_join(ax_t, by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(
    n_q010_consistent = pmin(
      (!is.na(m3_q) & m3_q < 0.10 & (is.na(expected_dir) | m3_dir == expected_dir)) +
      (!is.na(ld_q) & ld_q < 0.10 & (is.na(expected_dir) | ld_dir == expected_dir)) +
      (!is.na(ax_q) & ax_q < 0.10 & (is.na(expected_dir) | ax_dir == expected_dir)),
      3),
    n_p05_consistent = (
      (!is.na(m3_p) & m3_p < 0.05 & (is.na(expected_dir) | m3_dir == expected_dir)) +
      (!is.na(ld_p) & ld_p < 0.05 & (is.na(expected_dir) | ld_dir == expected_dir)) +
      (!is.na(ax_p) & ax_p < 0.05 & (is.na(expected_dir) | ax_dir == expected_dir))
    ),
    verdict = case_when(
      n_q010_consistent >= 1                            ~ "Replicated (locked rule)",
      n_p05_consistent  >= 2                            ~ "Directional concordance only",
      n_p05_consistent  == 1                            ~ "Single-method nominal",
      TRUE                                              ~ "Null"
    )
  )

cat("\n=== §13.5a Genus verification table ===\n")
print(verif_genus %>% select(feature, expected_dir,
                             m3_coef, m3_q, m3_dir,
                             ld_lfc, ld_q, ld_dir,
                             ax_est, ax_q, ax_dir,
                             n_q010_consistent, n_p05_consistent, verdict),
      width = Inf)

write_tsv(verif_genus, file.path(paths$out_dir, "verification_table_genus.tsv"))

# §13b — Combined-cohort pathway DA -------------------------------------

# 1. Feature universe: intersection of cohort-filtered pathways
shared_pwy <- intersect(rownames(path_pitt_f), rownames(path_sheba_f))
cat("Combined pathway feature set: ", length(shared_pwy), "\n", sep = "")

# 2. Combined matrix
path_combo <- cbind(
  path_pitt_f [shared_pwy, , drop = FALSE],
  path_sheba_f[shared_pwy, , drop = FALSE]
)

# 3. Combined metadata
needed_cols <- c("SampleID", "Cohort", "Response", "Treatment_regimen")
md_combo <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(pitt_qc$sample_table) [, needed_cols],
  as.data.frame(sheba_qc$sample_table)[, needed_cols]
)
rownames(md_combo) <- md_combo$SampleID

# Align matrix and metadata by sample
keep <- intersect(colnames(path_combo), rownames(md_combo))
path_combo <- path_combo[, keep, drop = FALSE]
md_combo   <- md_combo  [keep, , drop = FALSE]

md_combo$Response          <- factor(md_combo$Response,
                                     levels = c("Non_responder", "Responder"))
md_combo$Cohort            <- factor(md_combo$Cohort,
                                     levels = c("Sheba", "Pitt"))
md_combo$Treatment_regimen <- factor(md_combo$Treatment_regimen,
                                     levels = c("anti-PD1", "anti-PD1+anti-CTLA4"))

cat("Combined matrix: ", nrow(path_combo), " pathways × ",
    ncol(path_combo), " samples\n", sep = "")
cat("\nCohort × Response:\n");          print(with(md_combo, table(Cohort, Response)))
cat("\nCohort × Treatment_regimen:\n"); print(with(md_combo, table(Cohort, Treatment_regimen)))


# --- 13b-i. MaAsLin3 -------------------------------------------------
dir.create(file.path(paths$out_dir, "maaslin3_combined_pathway"),
           recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

m3_path <- maaslin3::maaslin3(
  input_data        = as.data.frame(t(path_combo)),   # samples × pathways
  input_metadata    = md_combo,
  output            = file.path(paths$out_dir, "maaslin3_combined_pathway"),
  fixed_effects     = c("Response", "Cohort", "Treatment_regimen"),
  reference         = "Response,Non_responder;Cohort,Sheba;Treatment_regimen,anti-PD1",
  normalization     = "TSS",
  transform         = "LOG",
  correction        = "BH",
  min_abundance     = 0,           # pre-filtered upstream
  min_prevalence    = 0,
  max_significance  = 0.10,
  cores             = 2,
  plot_summary_plot = FALSE,
  plot_associations = FALSE
)

m3_path_res <- m3_path$fit_data_abundance$results %>%
  filter(metadata == "Response") %>%
  arrange(qval_individual) %>%
  transmute(feature,
            m3_coef = coef,  m3_p = pval_individual,
            m3_q    = qval_individual,
            m3_dir  = ifelse(coef < 0, "NR", "R"))
cat("MaAsLin3 q<0.10 pathway hits:", sum(m3_path_res$m3_q < 0.10), "\n")


# --- 13b-ii. LinDA ---------------------------------------------------
ld_path <- MicrobiomeStat::linda(
  feature.dat       = path_combo,
  meta.dat          = md_combo,
  formula           = "~ Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen",
  feature.dat.type  = "proportion",
  prev.filter       = 0,
  mean.abund.filter = 0,
  adaptive          = TRUE,
  p.adj.method      = "BH",
  alpha             = 0.10
)

ld_path_res <- ld_path$output$ResponseResponder %>%
  rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>%
  transmute(feature,
            ld_lfc = log2FoldChange, ld_p = pvalue,
            ld_q   = padj,
            ld_dir = ifelse(log2FoldChange < 0, "NR", "R"))
cat("LinDA q<0.10 pathway hits:", sum(ld_path_res$ld_q < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")


# --- 13b-iii. ALDEx2 (aldex.glm with covariate adjustment) -----------
counts_pseudo_path <- round(path_combo * 1e6) + 1L
mm_path <- model.matrix(~ Response + Cohort + Treatment_regimen, data = md_combo)

set.seed(42)
ax_path_clr <- ALDEx2::aldex.clr(counts_pseudo_path, mm_path,
                                 mc.samples = 128, denom = "all")
ax_path_glm <- ALDEx2::aldex.glm(ax_path_clr, mm_path)

ax_path_res <- data.frame(
  feature = rownames(ax_path_glm),
  ax_est  = ax_path_glm[, "ResponseResponder:Est"],
  ax_p    = ax_path_glm[, "ResponseResponder:pval"],
  ax_q    = ax_path_glm[, "ResponseResponder:pval.padj"],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(ax_dir = ifelse(ax_est < 0, "NR", "R")) %>%
  arrange(ax_p)
cat("ALDEx2 q<0.10 pathway hits:", sum(ax_path_res$ax_q < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")


# --- Save & top-10 ---------------------------------------------------
write_tsv(m3_path_res, file.path(paths$out_dir, "DA_combined_pathway_maaslin3.tsv"))
write_tsv(ld_path_res, file.path(paths$out_dir, "DA_combined_pathway_linda.tsv"))
write_tsv(ax_path_res, file.path(paths$out_dir, "DA_combined_pathway_aldex2.tsv"))

cat("\n=== Pathway MaAsLin3 top 10 by q ===\n");  print(head(m3_path_res, 10))
cat("\n=== Pathway LinDA top 10 by p ===\n");     print(head(ld_path_res, 10))
cat("\n=== Pathway ALDEx2 top 10 by p ===\n");    print(head(ax_path_res, 10))

```
### 14a. Figures of combined metaphlan analysis
```{r}

# §14a — Combined genus heatmap ----------------------------------------
# CLR-transformed genus abundances on the 105 QC'd samples (33 Sheba + 70 Pitt
# minus the 5 QC-flagged); two evidence blocks: "§13.5a verification" and
# "Combined-cohort novel" (multi-method directional concordance at p<0.05).

# 1. Row selection ------------------------------------------------------
verif_genus_rows <- c("g__Slackia", "g__Eggerthella", "g__Lachnospira")

# Combined-cohort novel: 2-method directional concordance at p<0.05,
# matching the §13 multi-method pattern. Pull from the three result tables.
novel_genus_rows <- inner_join(
  m3_res %>% transmute(feature, m3_p = pval_individual, m3_dir = ifelse(coef < 0, "NR", "R")),
  ld_res %>% transmute(feature, ld_p = pvalue,          ld_dir = ifelse(log2FoldChange < 0, "NR", "R")),
  by = "feature"
) %>% inner_join(
  ax_res %>% transmute(feature, ax_p = pvalue,          ax_dir = ifelse(estimate < 0, "NR", "R")),
  by = "feature"
) %>%
  filter(!feature %in% verif_genus_rows) %>%   # don't double-count verification targets
  mutate(
    n_p05_concordant = (
      (!is.na(m3_p) & m3_p < 0.05) +
      (!is.na(ld_p) & ld_p < 0.05) +
      (!is.na(ax_p) & ax_p < 0.05)
    ),
    dir_consistent = (m3_dir == ld_dir) & (ld_dir == ax_dir)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_p05_concordant >= 2 & dir_consistent) %>%
  arrange(pmin(m3_p, ld_p, ax_p)) %>%
  pull(feature)

cat("Genus heatmap rows:\n")
cat("  §13.5a verification (", length(verif_genus_rows), "): ",
    paste(verif_genus_rows, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Combined novel (",      length(novel_genus_rows),  "): ",
    paste(novel_genus_rows,  collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")

heatmap_genera <- c(verif_genus_rows, novel_genus_rows)
stopifnot(all(heatmap_genera %in% rownames(combo_genus$otu_table)))

# 2. CLR transform on the selected rows ---------------------------------
otu_sel <- as.matrix(combo_genus$otu_table)[heatmap_genera, , drop = FALSE]
otu_pseudo <- otu_sel + min(otu_sel[otu_sel > 0]) / 2   # half-min pseudocount
clr_mat <- apply(otu_pseudo, 2, function(x) log(x) - mean(log(x)))

# Row z-score for visualization (already done by ComplexHeatmap row scaling
# but we'll be explicit and pre-scale)
clr_z <- t(scale(t(clr_mat)))

# 3. Annotation ---------------------------------------------------------
sm <- combo_genus$sample_table[colnames(clr_z), , drop = FALSE]
col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cohort   = sm$Cohort,
  Response = sm$Response,
  col = list(
    Cohort    = c("Sheba" = "#1b9e77", "Pitt"  = "#7570b3"),
    Response  = c("Non_responder" = "#ff7f00", "Responder" = "#6a3d9a")
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

# 4. Row-split blocks + clean labels (strip g__ prefix) -----------------
row_split <- factor(
  c(rep("§13.5a verification", length(verif_genus_rows)),
    rep("Combined-cohort novel", length(novel_genus_rows))),
  levels = c("§13.5a verification", "Combined-cohort novel")
)
row_labels <- sub("^g__", "", rownames(clr_z))

# 5. Build heatmap ------------------------------------------------------
ht_genus <- Heatmap(
  clr_z,
  name              = "CLR\n(z-scored)",
  top_annotation    = col_anno,
  column_split = sm$Cohort,    # 2 panels: Sheba | Pitt
  column_title      = NULL,
  column_order = order(sm$Cohort, sm$Response),   # NR before R within each
cluster_columns = FALSE,                        # respect explicit order
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  row_split         = row_split,
  row_title_rot     = 90,
  row_labels        = row_labels,
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontface = "italic", fontsize = 9),
  column_gap        = unit(2, "mm"),
  row_gap           = unit(2, "mm"),
  border            = TRUE,
  col               = circlize::colorRamp2(
    c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")
  )
)

# 6. Save ---------------------------------------------------------------
svg(file.path(paths$out_dir, "heatmap_combined_genus.svg"),
    width = 10, height = 0.45 * length(heatmap_genera) + 2.5)
draw(ht_genus, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

png(file.path(paths$out_dir, "heatmap_combined_genus.png"),
    width = 10, height = 0.45 * length(heatmap_genera) + 2.5,
    units = "in", res = 300)
draw(ht_genus, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

cat("Saved: heatmap_combined_genus.[svg|png]\n")
draw(ht_genus, merge_legend = TRUE)
```
